study.question: Does the occupied-batch centered auxiliary product-context derivative retain its click utility after restoring its full incoming norm, and does mean versus centered direction still matter at matched edge norm?
study.hypothesis: Observed single-seed full/product-blocked AUCs are0.6684156159937658/0.6678548720585206; centered/mean are0.668362209030126/0.6677052264624319. The centered gain above blocked is0.000507337, while mean is0.000149646 below blocked. This suggests useful row-dependent transfer, but projection changes norm as well as direction. Working hypothesis: component direction contributes beyond scalar edge energy; centered_fullnorm will exceed mean_fullnorm and remain above blocked. Whether it exceeds native centered or the incumbent is open, not assumed.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent implementation supplies occupied-batch mean/centered projection. Add only a training-backward magnitude intervention and its2x2 controls; inherited projection is not new.

Archived primary text lines202-266 verifies target-conditioned history activation/aggregation inherited in adapted form. This study changes only auxiliary context derivatives in an already stronger joint descendant, not DIN forward architecture.

Pinned benchmark forward lines123-170 constructs task-specific masked sequence hubs and task readouts. No hubs/broadcasts or external performance are imported; we retain existing forward information flow and investigate its auxiliary gradient contribution.

Original-paper provenance only; full original text is not available in this context. No original-method equivalence or novelty claim. Authorized search for gradient surgery/PCGrad/GradNorm returned no records; broader nearest optimization work remains unverified.

inherited_components: All source from history_g3_r0035_centered_only.py except declared VJP magnitude plumbing and validation; same FeatureEmbeddingDict, action-aware compressed activation, folded Dice support, pruned eval, masked target-match and ordinal summaries
Task-specific residual adapters, rank16 context-history product with bounded/RMS-normalized fusion, four prediction towers and true-label joint training_loss
Blocked auxiliary item/action/scorer/tower/residual-context edges; native click path; same train/eval ownership boundaries
study.proposed_difference: Prospective2x2 factorial: product_context_component in {centered,mean} x product_context_magnitude in {native,full_norm}. For each auxiliary-task product-context edge, O is nonempty-history occupancy, G=O*g, M=O*sum(G)/max(sum(O),1), C=O*(G-mean). Native returns P=M or C exactly as parent. Full_norm returns P/||P||_F*||G||_F if ||P||_F/||G||_F>1e-6 and ||G||_F>0, else zero. Max-absolute-scaled FP32 norm arithmetic avoids squaring tiny raw gradients and forming huge G/P scale ratios; no clipping or tuned scale. The numerical floor is fixed prospectively, never adjusted to outcomes. All coordinates and occupied rows share one scalar per auxiliary task; no normalization across tasks or sparse parameter rows. Identity forward plus prescribed first-order VJP is a surrogate training intervention, not the true derivative of a new scalar objective; no higher-order derivative claim. Nothing is applied in eval or to the click edge. This is local mechanism attribution, with global novelty unverified.
predictions: Native centered and native mean must reproduce ancestor probabilities/buffers/gradients at common state and, under deterministic host execution, their respective prior click trajectories; differences invalidate comparison until diagnosed. These are replay checks, not independent support.

At nondegenerate common states, both fullnorm components have L2 norm equal to their own common incoming occupied task VJP before sparse scatter; centered keeps zero occupied-row sum and mean keeps identical occupied rows. Empty rows are zero.

Centered_fullnorm will exceed mean_fullnorm in validation click AUC and remain above the existing blocked endpoint if component direction is useful beyond edge norm. Native/fullnorm differences and their component interaction are reported even if unfavorable. No prediction that any cell beats incumbent g3-r0034-joint_aligned AUC0.668473871997858.

Report four-task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately, inherited history-length bins0/1-16/17-64/65-100 with samples/positives/negatives, parameters, measured GPU/train/wall cost, peak memory, examples, inference throughput and batch p50/p95. Other authorized slices are exploratory. No confidence interval without an authorized user-cluster interface or independent paired seeds.
falsifiers: If mean_fullnorm matches/exceeds centered_fullnorm, a direction advantage independent of this edge-energy definition is unsupported.
If centered_fullnorm loses its advantage over blocked while centered_native replays successfully, reduced magnitude remains a viable explanation and the norm-restoration proposal is unsuccessful.

Any native replay failure, nonfinite derivative, changed common-state prediction/private gradient/RNG/state, mask leakage or failed tensor oracle invalidates mechanism interpretation; record failed costs and abort affected training.
Equal pre-scatter norms with strongly unequal coalesced sparse norms or optimizer steps prevents claiming parameter-update energy was controlled; report only context-edge norm control.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed validation selection and adaptive reuse may explain small differences; prior identical-seed replays are not independent evidence.
Earlier task-removal and fav/buy mass restoration did not improve click; this is not a universal claim that auxiliary tasks or larger auxiliary gradients help.

Product alignment/swap evidence may partly reflect batch pairing; mean/centered projection changes exposure-row geometry before repeated-ID scatter. Neither alone proves label-semantic transfer or click/auxiliary gradient conflict.
Full M+C can outperform either alone through interactions and optimizer state; mean-only harm does not imply the mean component is harmful in joint transfer.

Sparse Adagrad, embedding table sharing, task-gradient cancellation, near-degenerate projection and later trajectory feedback may mediate effects. Auxiliary labels are24h category/brand outcomes under official_offline visibility, not direct advertisement conversion attribution.
